title: Figure 1: Boundary Layer Development in Subsonic Flow About a Projectile
description: Schematic of airflow over the curved nose of a projectile (green shape), with streamlines flowing from right to left and an arrow marked 'Direction of Flow'. A dashed curve marks the 'Boundary Layer', and a small arrow profile shows the 'Velocity Distribution within the Boundary Layer'. The page also gives the Reynolds number expression Re = VD/ν.
